verses.english:
Such indeed is the Blessed One:
"Araham" - eradicated greed, hatred, delusion, craving, and is free of all taints.
"Sammasambuddho" - Understood the Four Noble Truths, the reality of life, without anyone’s help.
"Vijjacaranasampanno" - Perfect in True Knowledge and Conduct. Buddha acquired 3 kinds of knowledge: understood His past lives; understood the passing away and arising of other beings; understood the nature and the path to eradicate taints.
"Sugato" - Found and followed the Right Noble Eightfold Path (the Path leading to the cessation of Dukka).
"Lokavidu" - Understood the presence and origin of all the worlds (hell, ghost, animal, human, heavenly, and the pure abodes).
"Anuttaro purisadammasarathi" - Incomparable Leader of those to be tamed.
"Satta devamannussanam" - Teacher of gods and humans.
"Buddho" - Understood the Four Noble Truths without assistance and was able to teach Dhamma to others, without holding anything back.
"Bhagava" - Only a Buddha, the Supreme Teacher holds these great, extra-ordinary qualities.

verses.english:
"Svakkhato" - The Dhamma taught by the Blessed One is Excellent in the beginning, Excellent in the middle and Excellent in the end - all of Buddha's Discourses are consistent and teach the same truth.
"Sanditthika" - Dhamma is self-evident and can be understood in this life itself.
"Akaliko" - Dhamma, Noble Truths, can not be changed nor can they be altered over time.
"Ehipassiko" - "come and see"; Buddha's Dhamma is to be investigated.
"Opanayika" - Dhamma can only be understood by oneself.
"Paccattam vedittabbo vinnuhiti" - Dhamma is for the wise to understand and realize.

verses.sinhala: භාග්‍යවතුන් වහන්සේ ආර්ය මහා සංඝරත්නය සසුන් මගට මනාව පිළිපන් හෙයින් සුපටිපන්න නම් වන සේක. මධ්‍යම ප්‍රතිපදාවට පිළිපන් හෙයින් උජුපටිපන්න නම් වන සේක. නිවන් පිළිස මනාව පිලිපන් හෙයින් ඤායපටිපන්න නම් වන සේක. සසර දුක නැති කරන ප්‍රතිපදාවන්ට මනාව පිලිපන් හෙයින් සාමීචිපටිපන්න නම් වන සේක. දුර බැහැර සිට පූජා ද්‍රව්‍යයන් ගෙනවුත් පිදීමට සුදුසු වන හෙයින් ආහුණ්‍යෙය නම් වන සේක. දුර බැහැරින් එන ඤාතීන්ට පිළියෙල කළ භෝජන පූජා කිරීමට සුදුසු වන හෙයින් පාහුණ්‍යෙය නම් වන සේක. දෙඅත් මුදුනෙහි තබා වැඳීමට සුදුසු වන හෙයින් අඤ්ජලිකරණීය නම් වන සේක. ලෝකයාට උසස් වු පින් කෙතක් වන හෙයින් අනුත්තර පිඤ්ඤඛෙත්ත නම් වන සේක.
verses.english:
"Supatipanno" - The Order of the Blessed One are training to rid themselves of greed, hatred and delusion.
"Ujupatipanno" - They follow the direct, Noble Eightfold Path.
"Nayapatipanno" - The Noble Order understands the First Noble Truth and are practising to eradicate suffering
"Samicipatipanno" - The Orders spreads the message of Dhamma by sharing what the Buddha taught.
In Buddha’s Order are the 8 kinds of individuals: the one striving to Enter the Stream of the Noble Path, the one who has entered the Stream; the one striving to attain the position of Once-Returner, the Once-Returner; the one striving to reach the Non- returner position, the Non-Returner; the one striving for Arahantship and the Arahant. A field of merit is the supreme Sangha, worthy of gifts, worthy of hospitality, worthy of respect and worship.

අනේකේහි ගුණෝඝේහි - සබ්බසත්තුත්තමෝ අහූ
අනේකේහි උපායේහි - නරදම්මේ දමේසි ච
verses.pali_roman:
Anēkēhi gunogēhi - sabbasattuttamo ahu
Anēkēhi upāyēhi - naradhamme damēsi ca
verses.english: By innumerable ocean of qualities, he became supreme of all beings, by various means He tamed the tameable ones.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 18

verses.pali_si:
ඒකෝ සබ්බස්ස ලෝකස්ස - සබ්බ සත්තානුසාසකෝ
භාග්‍ය ඉස්සරියාදීනං - ගුණානං පරමෝ නිධි
verses.pali_roman:
Eko sabbassa lokassa - sabba sattānusāsako
Bhāgya issariyādīnan - gunānan paramo nidhi
verses.english:
He is the unique adviser in every aspect of welfare for the entire world.
He is the supreme repository for the qualities such as fortune and prosperity.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 19

verses.pali_si:
පඤ්ඤාස්ස සබ්බ ධම්මේසු - කරුණා සබ්බ ජන්තුසු
අත්තත්තානං පරත්තානං - සාධිකා ගුණජෙට්ඨිකා
verses.pali_roman:
Paññāssa sabba dhammēsu - karunā sabba jantusu
Atthatthānan paratthānan - sādhikā guna jetthikā
verses.english: His wisdom in all the phenomena, and compassion towards all beings - are the main qualities that benefit one and others.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 19

verses.pali_si:
දයාය පාරමී චිත්වා - පඤ්ඤායත්තාන මුද්ධරි
උද්ධරි සබ්බ ධම්මේ ච - දයායඤ්ඤේ ච උද්ධරි
verses.pali_roman:
Dayāya pārami citvā - paññāyattana muddhari
Uddhari sabba dhammē ca - dayāyaññē ca uddhari
verses.english:
He has cultivated perfections out of compassion and has liberated himself through wisdom;
By preaching the doctrine, in all aspects, out of compassion,  rescued others.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 19

verses.pali_si:
දිස්සමානෝපි තාවස්ස - රූපකායෝ අචින්තියෝ
අසාධාරණ ඤාණඩ්ඩේ - ධම්මකායේ කතාවකාති.
verses.pali_roman:
Dissamānopi tāvassa - rūpakāyo acintiyo
asādhārana ñānaddhē - dhamma kāyē kathāvakāti.
verses.english:
Though visible, his Rupa Kaya (physical body) was inconceivable.
So, what can be said about His Dhamma Kaya (Doctrinal body), enriched with his unique wisdom.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 19

audio.label: Chanted by Ven. Nauyane Ariyadhamma Thero

sections.heading: මෙත්තානුස්සතිය

source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed pages 19–20

verses.pali_si:
අත්තූපමාය සබ්බේසං - සත්තානං සුඛකාමතං
පස්සිත්වා ඛමතෝ මෙත්තං - සබ්බ සත්තේසු භාවයේ
verses.pali_roman:
Attūpamāya sabbēsan - sattānan sukhakhāmatan
Passitvā khamato mettan - sabba sattēsu bhāvayē
verses.english:
Having compared oneself with others, have a desire for the happiness of all living beings.
Having seen it, one should develop loving kindness towards all living beings.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 20

verses.pali_si:
සුඛී භවෙය්‍යං නිද්දුක්ඛෝ - අහං නිච්චං අහං විය
හිතා ච මේ සුඛී හොන්තු - මජ්ඣත්තා තච වේරිනෝ
verses.pali_roman:
Sukhī bhaveyyan niddhukkho - ahan niccan ahan viya
Hitā ca mē sukhī hontu - majjatthā thaca vērino
verses.english: May I always be happy and free from suffering and like myself, may my friends, neutral persons and hostile persons always be happy.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 20

verses.pali_si:
ඉමම්හි ගාමක්ඛෙත්තම්හි - සත්තා හොන්තු සුඛී සදා
තතෝ පරඤ්ච රජ්ජේසු - චක්කවාලේසු ජන්තුනෝ
verses.pali_roman:
Imamhi gāmakkettamhi - sattā hontu sukhī sadā
tato parañ ca rajjēsu - cakkavālēsu jantuno
verses.english: may the beings in this village, vicinity always be happy and those who live in other countries and the ones who live in all the world systems, be well and happy.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 20

verses.pali_si:
සමන්තා චක්කවාලේසු - සත්තානන්තේසු පානිනෝ
සුඛිනෝ පුග්ගලා භූතා - අත්තභාවගතා සියුං
verses.pali_roman:
samantā cakkavālēsu - sattānantēsu panino
sukhino puggalā bhūtā - attabhāva gatā siyun
verses.english: Those living in the infinite surrounding world systems, all persons creatures and all living beings be well and happy;

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 20

verses.pali_si:
තථා ඉත්ථී පුමා චේව - අරියා අනරියාපි ච
දේවා නරා අපායට්ඨා - තථා දසදිසාසු චාති
verses.pali_roman:
tathā itthi pumā cēva - ariyā anariyāpi ca
dēvā narā apāyatthā - tathā dasa disāsu cāti
verses.english: likewise, female, male, noble ones, ignoble ones, gods, humans, the ones in woeful states, and all those in the ten directions be well and happy.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 20

audio.label: Chanted by Ven. Nauyane Ariyadhamma Thero

sections.heading: අසුභානුස්සතිය
notes: Converted from the booklet's FM font; to be read against printed pages 21–22.

source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed pages 21–22

verses.pali_si:
අවිඤ්ඤාණසුභනිභං - සවිඤ්ඤාණ සුභං ඉමං
කායං අසුභතෝ පස්සං - අසුභං භාවයේ සති
verses.pali_roman:
Aviññāna subhaniban - saviññana subhan iman
Kāyan asubhato passan - asubhan bhāvayē sati
verses.english: Seeing the body unattractive with both with and without the consciousness, a meditator should reflect (meditate) on the loathsomeness of the body.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 21

verses.pali_si:
වණ්ණසණ්ඨාන ගන්ධේහි - ආසයෝ කාසතෝ තථා
පටික්කූලානි කායේ මේ - කුණපානි ද්විසෝලස
verses.pali_roman:
Vanna santāna gandhēhi - āsayo kāsato tathā
patikkūlāni kāyē mē - kunapānidvisolasa
verses.english:
By way of their colour, shape, smell, associated location space and appearance;
The thirty-two parts of the body are repulsive

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 21

verses.pali_si:
පතිතම්හාපි කුණපා - ජෙගුච්ඡං කායනිස්සිතං
ආධාරෝහි සුචී තස්ස - කායේතු කුණපේ ඨිතං
verses.pali_roman:
Patitamhāpi kunapā - jēgucchan kāya nissitan
Ādhārohi sucī tassa - kāyētu kunapē thitan
verses.english:
The impurities that are still remaining in the body are more disgusting than the ones which have fallen down.
because the place upon where they have been fallen down is pure, but when they are in the body those impurities are in a foul body.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 21

verses.pali_si:
මීල්හේ කිමිව කායෝයං - අසුචිම්හි සමුට්ඨිතෝ
අන්තෝ අසුචි සම්පුන්නෝ - පුණ්ණවච්චකුටී විය
verses.pali_roman:
Mīlhē kimiva kāyoyan - asucimhi samitthito
Anto asuci sampunno - punna vaccakutī viya
verses.english:
Just like a worm that is born in the filth, this body also is born in the filth.
This body is full of filth like a cesspit full of filth.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 21

verses.pali_si:
අසුචි සන්දතේ නිච්චං - යථා මේදකථාලිකා
නානාකිමි කුලාවාසෝ - පක්ඛචන්දනිකා විය
verses.pali_roman:
Asuci sandatē niccan - yathā mēdakathālikā
Nānākimi kulāvāso - pakkacandanikā viya
verses.english:
Impure matters always flow out from this body constantly just like fat from a clay-pot when it is full.
Just like a cesspool, this body is the home for various kinds of worms.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 22

verses.pali_si:
ගණ්ඩභූතෝ රෝගභූතෝ - වණභූතෝ සමුස්සයෝ
අතේකිච්ඡෝති ජේගුච්ඡෝ - පභින්නකුණපූපමෝති
verses.pali_roman:
Gandabhūto rogabhūto - vanabhūto samussayo
Atēkicchoti gēguccho - Pabhinna kunapūpamoti.
verses.english:
This body is like a boil, a disease, an incurable wound,
Extremely, repulsive and fragile. It is comparable to a decomposed corpse.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 22

audio.label: Chanted by Ven. Nauyane Ariyadhamma Thero

sections.heading: මරණානුස්සතිය
notes: Converted from the booklet's FM font; to be read against printed pages 22–23.

source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed pages 22–23

verses.pali_si:
පවාතදීප තුල්‍යාය - සායුසන්ත තියාක්කයං
පරූපමාය සම්පස්සං - භාවයේ මරණස්සති
verses.pali_roman:
Pavāta dīpa tulyāya - sāyu santa tiyākkhayan
Parūpamāya sampassan - bhāvayē maranassati
verses.english:
Seeing with wisdom, the end of life in others and comparing this to a lamp
Kept in windy place, one should meditate on death.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 22

verses.pali_si:
මහා සම්පත්ති සම්පත්තා - යථා සත්තා මතා ඉධ
තථා අහං මරිස්සාමි - මරණං මම හෙස්සති
verses.pali_roman:
Mahāsampatti sampattā - yathā sattā matā idha
Tathā ahan marissāmi - maranan mama hessati
verses.english: Just as persons in this world who achieved great wealth and success have passed away, the same way I too will die.  For sure, the death will come to me.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 22

verses.pali_si:
උප්පත්තියා සහේවේදං - මරණං ආගතං සදා
මරණත්තාය ඕකාසං - වධකෝ විය ඒසති
verses.pali_roman:
Uppattiyā sahē vēdan - maranan āgatan sadā
Maranattāya okāsan - vadako viya ēsati
verses.english: The death always comes alone, together with birth, looking for an opportunity, as an executioner would do.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 22

verses.pali_si:
ඊසකං අනිවත්තන්තං - සතතං ගමනුස්සුකං
ජීවිතං උදයා අත්ථං - සුරියෝ විය ධාවති
verses.pali_roman:
Īsakan anivattantan - satatan gamanussukan
Jīvitan udayā atthan - suriyo viya dhāvati
verses.english:
The life, without stopping even for a moment, and ever keen on moving,
Runs like the sun that hastens to set after its rise.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 23

verses.pali_si:
විජ්ජුබුබ්බුල උස්සාව - ජලරාජී පරික්ඛයං
ඝාතකෝව රිපූතස්ස - සබ්බත්ථාපි අවාරියෝ

Vijju bubbula ussāva - jalarāji parikkhayan
Ghātakova ripūtassa - sabbatthāpi avāriyo
verses.english:
This life is fragile, like a lightning, a bubble, a dew drop on a leaf or a line drawn on the water.
Like an enemy intent on killing, death can never be avoided.

Suyasatthāma puññiddhi - buddhivuddhi jinaddvayan
Ghātēsi maranan khippan - kātu mādisakē kata?
verses.english: If the Death quickly killed the conqueror (The Buddha), who possessed great fame, strength, merit and supernatural powers. What can be said of one like me?

Paccayānañca vēkalyā – bāhirajjattupaddavā
Marāmoran nimēsāpi - maranāno anukkhananti.
verses.english:
When there is a deficiency in conditions for life or some inner or outer danger
I would die at any moment within a blink of an eye.

ජාති ජරා ව්‍යාධි ච්‍යුති අපායා - අතීත අප්පත්තක වට්ට දුක්ඛං

verses.pali_roman:
Jāti jarā vyadhi cyuti apāyā - atīta appattaka vatta dukkhan
Idāni āhāra gavetthi dukkhan - sanvēga vatthūni imāni attha.
verses.english: Birth, old age, illness, death, miseries underwent in the hells, miseries underwent in the past lives, miseries yet to come in the future lives and miseries experience in the present life are called eight-fold miseries.

පාතෝ ච සායමපිචේව ඉමං විධිඤ්ඤෝ

Pāto ca sāya mapicēva iman vidhiñño
Āsēvatē satatamatta hitābhilāsī
Pappoti soti vipulan hata pāri panto
Setthan sukhan muni visitthamatan sukhēnacāti.

verses.pali_si:
අවිජ්ජා පච්චයා සංඛාරා, සංඛාර පච්චයා විඤ්ඤාණං,
විඤ්ඤාණ පච්චයා නාමරූපං, නාමරූප පච්චයා සලායතනං,
සලායතන පච්චයා ඵස්සෝ, ඵස්ස පච්චයා වේදනා, වේදනා
පච්චයා තණ්හා, තණ්හා පච්චයා උපාදානං, උපාදාන පච්චයා
භවෝ, භව පච්චයා ජාති,  ජාති පච්චයා ජරා මරණං, සෝක
පරිදේව දුක්ඛ දෝමනස්සුපායාසා සම්භවන්ති. ඒවමේතස්ස
කේවලස්ස දුක්ඛක්ඛන්ධස්ස සමුදයෝ හෝතීති.
verses.pali_roman:
Avijjāpaccayā sankhārā, Sankhāra paccayā viññāṇan,
Viññāṇa paccayā nāma-rūpan, Nāma-rūpa paccayā
saḷāyatanan,
Saḷāyatana paccayā phasso, Phassa paccayā vēdanā, Vēdanā
paccayā taṇhā,
Taṇhā paccayā upādānan, Upādāna paccayā bhavo, Bhava
paccayā jāti, Jāti paccayā jarā maraṇan, Soka paridēva,
dukkha domanassupāyāsā
sambhavanti, Ēvamētassa kēvalassa, dukkhakkhandhassa,
samudayo hoti’ti.
verses.english:
Dependent on ignorance arise volitional activities (moral and immoral), Dependent on volitional activities arises consciousness,
Dependent on consciousness arise mind and matter, Dependent on mind and matter arise the six spheres of sense,
Dependent on six spheres of sense arises contact, Dependent on contact arises sensation,
Dependent on sensation arises craving, Dependent on craving arises grasping, Dependent on grasping arises becoming,
Dependent on becoming arises birth, Dependent on birth arises decay, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief and despair; Thus, the entire mass of suffering arises.

verses.pali_si:
අවිජ්ජායත්වේව අසේස විරාග නිරෝධා සංඛාර නිරෝධෝ,
සංඛාර නිරෝධා විඤ්ඤාණ නිරෝධෝ, විඤ්ඤාණ නිරෝධා
නාමරූප නිරෝධෝ, නාමරූප නිරෝධා සලායතන නිරෝධෝ,
සලායතන නිරෝධා ඵස්ස නිරෝධෝ, ඵස්ස නිරෝධා වේදනා
නිරෝධෝ, වේදනා නිරෝධා තණ්හා නිරෝධෝ, තණ්හා
නිරෝධා උපාදාන නිරෝධෝ, උපාදාන නිරෝධා භව නිරෝධෝ,
භව නිරෝධා ජාති නිරෝධෝ,  ජාති නිරෝධා ජරා මරණං,
සෝක පරිදේව දුක්ඛ දෝමනස්සුපායාසා නිරුජ්ඣන්ති.
ඒවමේතස්ස කේවලස්ස දුක්ඛක්ඛන්ධස්ස නිරෝධෝ හෝතීති.
verses.pali_roman:
Avijjāyatvēva asēsa virāga nirodhā saṅkhāra nirodho,
Saṅkhāra nirodhā viññaṇa nirodho, Viññāṇa nirodhā nāma-
rūpa nirodho,
Nāma- rūpa nirodhā saḷāyatana nirodho, Saḷāyatana nirodhā
phassa nirodho,
Phassa nirodhā vēdanā nirodho, Vēdanā nirodhā tanhā
nirodho,
Taṇhā nirodhā upādāna nirodho, Upādāna nirodhā bhava
nirodho,
Bhava nirodhā jāti nirodho, Jāti nirodhā jarā maraṇaṃ, soka
paridēva,
dukkha domanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti. Ēvamētassa
kēvalassa,
dukkhakkhandassa nirodho hoti’ti.
verses.english:
The complete cessation of ignorance leads to the cessation of volitional activities. The cessation of volitional activities lead to the cessation of consciousness. The cessation of consciousness leads to the cessation of mind and matter.
The cessation of mind and matter leads to the cessation of six spheres of sense.
The cessation of six spheres of sense leads to the cessation of contact. The cessation of contact leads to the cessation of sensation.
The cessation of sensation leads to the cessation of craving. The cessation of craving leads - to the cessation of grasping. The cessation of grasping leads to the cessation of becoming.
The cessation of becoming - leads to the cessation of birth. The cessation of birth leads to the cessation of decay, death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief and despair. Thus, entire mass of suffering ceases.

The Noble Eightfold Path, that leads the way to suffering’s end.

සබ්බේ සංඛාරා අනිච්චාති - යදා පඤ්ඤාය පස්සති
අථ නිබ්බින්දතී දුක්ඛේ - ඒස මග්ගෝ විසුද්ධියා

Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti - yadā paññāya passati
Atha nibbindati dukkhe - esa maggo visuddhiyā
verses.english:
‘Impermanent are all conditioned things’, when with wisdom this is seen
One feels weary of all dukkha; this is the path to purity.

අප්පකාතේ මනුස්සේසු - යේ ජනා පාරගාමිනෝ
අථායං ඉතරා පජා - තීරමේවානුධාවති
verses.pali_roman:
Appakā te manussesu - ye janā pāragāmino
Athāyaṃ itarā pajā - tīramevānudhāvati
verses.english:
Few amongst humankind, are those who go beyond,
Yet there are the many folks, ever wandering on this shore.

යේ ච ඛෝ සම්ම දක්ඛාතේ - ධම්මේ ධම්මානුවත්තිනෝ
තේ ජනා පාරමෙස්සන්ති - මච්චුධෙය්‍යං සුදුත්තරං
verses.pali_roman:
Ye ca kho sammadakkhāte - dhamme dhammānuvattino
Te janā pāramessanti - maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ
verses.english:
Wherever Dhamma is well-taught, those who train in line with it
Are the ones who will cross over, the realm of death so hard to flee.

verses.pali_si:
අහං අවේරෝ හෝමි, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣෝ හෝමි, අනීඝෝ හෝමි

attānam pariharāmi.
verses.english: May I be free from enmity and danger, May I be free from mental suffering, May I be free from physical suffering. May I take care of myself happily.

verses.pali_si:
මම මාතා පිතූ, ආචරියා ච ඤාතිමිත්තා ච, සබ්‍රහ්මචාරිනෝ ච,
අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී
අත්තානං පරිහරන්තු.
verses.pali_roman:
Mama mātā pitu, ācariya ca ñātimitta ca, sabrahma cārino
ca, avēra hontu,
abyāpajjha hontu, anīgha hontu, sukhi attānam pariharantu.
verses.english: May my parents, teachers relatives and friends, fellow Dhamma farers, be free from enmity and danger, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, may they take care of themselves happily.

අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං

verses.pali_si:
ඉමස්මිං ආරාමේ, සබ්බේ භික්ඛු සාමණේරා ච, උපාසක
උපාසිකායෝ ච, අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු,
අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං පරිහරන්තු.
verses.pali_roman:
Imasmim ārāme, sabbe bhikkhu sāmanēra ca, upāsaka
upāsikayo ca,
avēra hontu, abyāpajjha hontu, anīgha hontu, sukhi
attānam pariharantu.
verses.english: May all monks in this compound, novice monks, laymen and laywomen disciples, be free from enmity and danger, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, May they take care of themselves happily.

verses.pali_si:
අම්හාකං චතුපච්චය දායකා අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා
හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං පරිහරන්තු.
verses.pali_roman:
Amhākam catupaccaya dāyaka, avēra hontu, abyāpajjha
hontu,
anīgha hontu, sukhi attānam pariharantu.
verses.english: May our donors of the four supports: clothing, food, medicine and lodging, be free from enmity and danger, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, May they take care of themselves happily.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 31

verses.pali_si:
අම්හාකං ආරක්ඛ දේවතා, ඉමස්මිං විහාරේ, ඉමස්මිං ආවාසේ,
ඉමස්මිං ආරාමේ, ආරක්ඛ දේවතා, අවේරා හොන්තු,
අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං
පරිහරන්තු.
verses.pali_roman:
Amhākam ārakkha dēvata, Imasmim vihāre, Imasmim
āvāse,
Imasmim ārāme, arākkha dēvata, avēra hontu, abyāpajjha
hontu,
anīgha hontu, sukhi attānam pariharantu.
verses.english: May our guardian devas, in this monastery, in this dwelling, in this compound, May the guardian devas, be free from enmity and danger, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, may they take care of themselves happily.

verses.pali_si:
සබ්බේ සත්තා, සබ්බේ පානා, සබ්බේ භූතා, සබ්බේ පුග්ගලා,
සබ්බේ අත්තභාවපරියාපන්නා, සබ්බා ඉත්ථීයො, සබ්බේ
පුරිසා, සබ්බේ අරියා, සබ්බේ අනරියා, සබ්බේ දේවා, සබ්බේ
මනුස්සා, සබ්බේ විනිපාතිකා, අවේරා හොන්තු, අබ්‍යාපජ්ඣා
හොන්තු, අනීඝා හොන්තු, සුඛී අත්තානං පරිහරන්තු, දුක්ඛා
මුච්චන්තු, යථා ලද්ධ සම්පත්තිතෝ මාවිගච්ඡන්තු,
කම්මස්සකා.
verses.pali_roman:
Sabbe satta, sabbe pāna, sabbe bhuta, sabbe puggala, sabbe
attabhāva pariyapanna,
sabba itthiyo, sabbe purisa, sabbe ariya, sabbe anariya,
sabbe dēva, sabbe manussa, sabbe vinipātika, avēra hontu,
abyāpajjha hontu, anīgha hontu, sukhi attānam pariharantu,
Dukkha muccantu,
Yatha laddha sampattito māvigacchantu, Kammassaka.
verses.english:
May all beings, all breathing things, all creatures, all individuals (all beings), all personalities
(all beings with mind and body), may all females, all males, all noble, ones (saints), all worldlings (those yet to attain sainthood), all devas (deities), all humans, all those in the four woeful planes, be free from enmity and dangers, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, may they take care of themselves happily, May all being be free from suffering, May whatever they have gained not be lost, All beings are owners of their own Kamma.

english_source.name: Shanthi Vihara, Nottingham — Evening Puja and Chanting
english_source.locator: evening_puja_and_chanting.pdf (supplied by the app's owner, 2026-11-17), printed page 31

verses.pali_si:
පුරත්ථීමාය දිසාය, පච්ඡිමාය දිසාය, උත්තරාය දිසාය,
දක්ඛිණාය දිසාය, පුරත්ථීමාය අනුදිසාය, පච්ඡිමාය අනුදිසාය,
උත්තරාය අනුදිසාය, දක්ඛිණාය අනුදිසාය, හෙට්ඨිමාය දිසාය,
උපරිමාය දිසාය, සබ්බේ සත්තා, සබ්බේ පානා, සබ්බේ භූතා,
සබ්බේ පුග්ගලා, සබ්බේ අත්තභාවපරියාපන්නා, සබ්බා
ඉත්ථීයො, සබ්බේ පුරිසා, සබ්බේ අරියා, සබ්බේ අනරියා,

verses.english:
In the eastern direction, in the western direction, in the northern direction, in the southern direction, in the
Southeast direction, in the northwest direction, in the northeast direction, in the southwest direction, in the direction below, in the direction above, May all beings, all breathing things, all creatures, all individuals (all beings), all personalities (all beings with mind and body) may all females, all males, all noble ones
(saints), those yet to attain all personalities (all beings with mind and body) may all females, all males, all noble ones
(saints), those yet to attain sainthood, all devas (deities), all humans, all those in the four woeful planes, be free from enmity and dangers, be free from mental suffering, be free from physical suffering, may they take care of themselves happily, May all beings be free from suffering, May whatever they have gained not be lost, all beings are owners of their own kamma
